event_invariants: Sample age derives from retained timestamps and custody; a new aliquot is not a new polymer batch.

Model-predicted tractions/surface tensions remain model output linked to inputs, not sensor output.
Repeated frames/timepoints cannot increase independent droplet/sample counts.
Calibration expiry, changed mount, sample reassignment or parameter changes invalidate dependent receipts.
Failure, exclusion and retry records remain visible; no overwriting failed run with its replacement.
Source numerical outcomes and synthetic fixtures can never satisfy an observed-experiment gate.
